scripts.build: vite build && webpack --config webpack.config.mjs && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.ts --outDir dist/server
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && playwright test && pnpm test:nuxt && pnpm test:consumers && pnpm test:docs && pnpm test:movies && pnpm test:atelier
scripts.test:nuxt: pnpm --filter vboxssr build && playwright test --config playwright.nuxt.config.ts
scripts.test:consumers: pnpm --filter @vbox/playground type-check && pnpm --filter vboxssr type-check && playwright test --config playwright.playground.config.ts && pnpm --filter @vbox/playground build-only && PLAYGROUND_PRODUCTION=true playwright test --config playwright.playground.config.ts && NUXT_DEVELOPMENT=true playwright test --config playwright.nuxt.config.ts
scripts.test:docs: pnpm --filter docs type-check && pnpm --filter docs build && node --test tests/docs-snippets.test.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.docs.config.ts
scripts.test:movies: pnpm --filter @vbox/movies type-check && playwright test --config playwright.movies.config.ts && VITE_TMDB_API_KEY=acceptance-placeholder pnpm --filter @vbox/movies build-only && MOVIES_PRODUCTION=true playwright test --config playwright.movies.config.ts
scripts.test:atelier: pnpm --filter @vbox/atelier type-check && playwright test --config playwright.atelier.config.ts && pnpm --filter @vbox/atelier build-only && ATELIER_PRODUCTION=true playwright test --config playwright.atelier.config.ts
